articles.title: Caféen is Being Expanded, Events Temporarily Move Outside
articles.author: Ariana Kalsbeek
articles.summary: SDU Sønderborg's student bar is under construction for a major expansion. Events will move outside or to temporary locations while the work continues.

articles.title: Two New Business Masters Starting in September
articles.author: News Desk
articles.summary: SDU Sønderborg adds two new master's programmes this autumn — Global Supply Chain Management and Marketing, Social Media and Digitalization.

articles.title: 623 New Students Starting this Semester
articles.author: News Desk
articles.summary: This autumn, 623 students have been offered a place at SDU Sønderborg — 121 fewer than in 2025, a decline of around 16 percent compared to last year.

articles.title: FEM Installs Menstrual Product Dispensers Across Campus Bathrooms
articles.author: News Desk
articles.summary: After a period of inactivity, student organisation FEM has relaunched and installed three free menstrual product dispensers in bathrooms across campus.

articles.title: Frank Robert Barin Joins Sønderborg as Programme Coordinator for Engineering
articles.author: News Desk
articles.summary: Frank Robert Barin has taken up the role of programme coordinator for Engineering, while former coordinator Christina moves into a senior advisory position.

articles.title: A Conversation with Mechatronics Head of Programme
articles.author: Farkas Angelus
articles.summary: We sat down with Andrei-Alexandru Popa, the new head of mechatronics at SDU Sønderborg, on his vision for the programme and what it means to study mechatronics.

articles.title: Festival and Party Replace Intro Tour this Semester
articles.author: News Desk
articles.summary: The annual Intro Tour has been cancelled due to a lack of funding. An Intro Party and the largest-ever Intro Festival will be held in its place.

articles.title: Deadline Is Holding a Photo Competition
articles.summary: We're hosting a photo competition on the theme of Sønderborg. Submit your photos and vote for your favourite before the 21st of September.

articles.title: Student Launches Website Listing Every Student Housing Option in Sønderborg
articles.author: Ariana Kalsbeek
articles.summary: Electronics Engineering student Andrea Bortolotti built studenthousingsonderborg.app — a platform covering every dorm, with vacancies, pricing, and commute times.

articles.title: Shopping in Sønderborg
articles.author: Sellei Máté
articles.summary: A guide to shopping in Sønderborg for new and returning students — convenience stores, second-hand shops, online options, and walking times from the dorms.

articles.title: Four Student Organisations Create a Day of Games, Crafting and Dance
articles.author: Ariana Kalsbeek
articles.summary: SDU Boardgames, Tengoku, D&D League and The Yarn Society brought students together for an afternoon of games, crafting, tea and dancing at Alsion.

articles.title: SDU turns 60, commemoration held on campus
articles.author: Máté Sellei
articles.summary: SDU Sønderborg marked the university's 60th anniversary with a campus commemoration led by Rector Jens Ringsmose and attended by students, staff and community members.

articles.title: Intro Festival Brings Music, Activities and Students Together Despite the Rain
articles.author: Ariana Kalsbeek
articles.summary: Students gathered at Ringriderpladsen for the Intro Festival, where live music, activities and student organisations welcomed the new semester despite the rain.
